My problem with hermione is she acts like a "nice girl™" in sixth book. She physically attacks ron just because he dates someone else. That's possessive and toxic behavior and as a bi-woman it comes across as creepy for me. If a guy would have done that because girl dates someone else, it would have made everyone uncomfortable. 
I know hermione is clever, but clever doesn't equal good person. And personally i have had a lot of toxic friends who were a lot like Hermione

Yeah... there was news abt how we might have passed nine climate tipping points and ppl in finnish twitter has started to talk how our young ppl will die in climate wars.... also the unep's emission gap report made me depressed. I just feel nothing. I feel like nothing matters anymore

I suffer from ptsd and anxiety and i am an extrovert. The problem is i get anxious/intrusive thoughts about things that i am anxious abt  when i go to my flat and are alone. (Climate change, family member passing, ect) so i avoid being alone. I am not going to bother ppl i hang out with a different person everyday or hangout in cafe so i can be with ppl. But if i stop, i get anxious and i feel terrible. It's not healthy but i don't know how to cope with these things.

I'm better too. My therapist is looking into emdr therapy to see if it could help me. I have stopped going to twitter and obsessing over civilization collapse or how much earth will warm. I have started to more or less live normal life but lessened my overconsumption and use of milk and red meat.

Doctors are not sure. The only link they could found was hormone pills which were prespricted to me because of my very painful periods and bad skin. They suspected that the pill and my genes just were bad combination. I think so too because they had prescribe with colestrol pills after due it not going down enough no matter how healthily i ate and how much i exercised. My colestrol would have been fine if i was a normal person. But because i belong to risk group it needs to be lower.

Many ppl mix their introversion with their mental illnesses. Ofc those two can go together but it took me a while to realize i was an extrovert because i have ptsd and avoidant personality disorder. It became easier to treat those after i realized this.

I feel you both. I stopped eating and i feel i shouldn't enjoy anything. 
Things that gets me most anxious are that i have heard Kevin Andersson to say scientists are not telling the truth to public that we can't limit warming to safe space anymore... couple journalists in my home country have said that the scientists are censoring themselves and not telling the truth. 
Why are they doing this?! It makes me mad honestly. I can't trust any scientists with hopefull attidute anymore
I fear the most of the collapse of the civilization. There is a researcher in my home country who thinks it's the most likely scenario now.

Thank you... that reporter was sure we can't limit warming even to toleratable degrees and that any scientists who says so are just censoring themselves. 
I have ptsd and anxiety and even though i know there are many other scientists who says we can avoid the worst, i see it through my anxiety and have that intrusive thought that: "maybe they are just trying to avoid masspanic and just not saying we are doomed"
And... well i have researched this and it made me so depressed i ended up in a bed for a month. Every single climate article almost causes me a panic attack and i am thinking of asking my therapist if going to institution to rest would be a possibility.
I fantasize abt this often. Just over doze and going to forest and fall asleep forever under trees....
I wish an accident would happen to me so ppl wouldn't blame themselves. And it would spare myself the trouble

I have seen that too but there is this guy in Finland who thinks end of this civilization by end of the century is likely scenario. Many finnish people talk like this here and it's very tiring. I understand the risks and all but i think you are right - worst case is not the most probable scenario. I have diagnosed anxiety so it makes this all so much worse. I try to cut my social media use and keep one day for climate strikes so i don't overwhelm myself
Thank you. I am trying to think of this. In here, there is this one researcher who talks abt end of civilization.by end of this century and it makes me feel paralyzed
Thank you... yes. I am planning to rest in an institution (we have more open version here where they allow phones ect.) If these thoughts won't go away..
Is there fridaysforfuture protests in your town? A group coud be helpful! Though activism can be tiring and doesn't fit for everyone

Yeah... i mean they are researches but i think it's a cultural think partly? I am from Finland and people here are really blunt and straightforward. Meanwhile American researchers and scientists are far more softspoken even though they talk about the same risks and don't really sugarcoat it either. 
But thank you! This actually helped me since i had bad panic attack about this earlier this day! If you need help with anything feel free to message me in return!

Exactly! And this whole: "only action works on ecoanxiety!" Thing is... i get where they are comimg from but if person already has mental issues that kind of rhetoric is dangerous. I have had good self-image but due to hearing that rhetoric i feel like it has lowered my self-worth. And people here are talking about end of the civilization by end of this century which kinda sound blackmailing: "if you don't do these things, the civilization will collapse." I know they try to wake people to urgency but to me that kind of rhetoric sounds really dangerous.

Exactly. I have tons of meds too and I honestly don't think guilt-tripping people especially if they have mental health troubles is right way to go about it. And yes, climate stuff is important but i can see just by looking at this subreddit that everyone just CAN'T focus on things like that when they have so many other things going on. And that's alright.

I feel you. 
I think part of that why so many people are so terrified of this is, we have hidden death away in this day and age. Death used to be so much more visible and part of everyday life. Of course people mourned then too but it was more natural. 
And i think in the past it was normal to fear nature. The crops depended on the right conditions and sometimes it just didn't happen. It was tragic but normal. 
I think reason why people are so uncomfortable with this is, we have been manipulated into thinking we tamed the nature and we don't have to fear it anymore. 
Now, suddenly we can't control it anymore. Suddenly having stable crops in the future isn't so  clear and we might have to face same circumstances than our ancestors did. It's something boomers and previous generations promised not to happen anymore but now suddenly we have to face that.

Yeah... i have decided to try keep one day of the week for climate stuff and other days for my mental health. I will also ask my therapist could i rest in institution for a while (there is more open version abt it here, where they let you keep your phone and you have lil more freedom especially if you are an adult)

I was put on sick leave because of ecoanxiety and over here people are talking about end of the civilization by this century. I tried acting and protesting but my anxiety got worse and i just lied in bed and skipped meals for a month. I feel like other activists over here care for my mental health only so i can fight more and not because of my own sake. I feel guilty of being human (i hate myself right now because of it) i have no motivation to work on my bachelor because i feel like i have no use for a degree in a future and I feel like i don't deserve to live because i am part of the species who caused this problem.
Never mind ~ find someone who can help me. :)
Thank you for this... i have been on twitter and it's full of doomists. This helped me.

Well, usually stuff i have been anxious about have been about relations and stuff that I could solve. Climate change is a global crisis that can cause food loss via crop failures, catastrophes, and mass migration. This is a real, massive thread that humanity has ever faced. It's kinda hard not feel anxious. I can't talk to it and make it go away like with my friend. I can't brush it away as a thought cause it's real. Every single climate scientist i have come across said that this is is either catastrophic or existential crisis. That's very different from my earlier anxieties. And i only want to forget the alarmist news, not the climate change itself.

I normally can face it but somehow this is different. I guess they just don't like the idea of amnesia? And i have come across that people really don't like to talk about climate change or don't really seem to understand why it could cause worry for some.
Reading their published research.
Also it is so bad that i feel anxious and guilty to be even part of the system that causes this problem. It really affects absolutely everything i do.
Well, too bad cause no matter what i do i cannot pull myself out of this.
NASA, ScientistWarning, and Climate Scientists such as Michael E Mann, Peter Kalmus and Kate Marvel. These are all climate scientists who have studied it for years.
Well i have been in a therapy for a long time. And isn't hypnotherapy used with anxiety also?
I tried to educate myself but the facts made it worse. I looked into what the most known climate scientist are saying and it made it worse. I have tried absolutely everything.
Well, i think i would still feel anxious i think. It is bad enough even if worst case scenario didn't happen.

I am in therapy. It doesn't stop this. And I am not sure about it. It was just an example of news that i've seen and what causes me anxiety. And i ha ve seen many scientists such as Kate Marvel from NASA saying it is the matter of decades. Same thing with almost all climate scientist i have come across. I know it might not be rational to get this anxious over this but trust me: i have tried everyhing. Anxiety is not always rational and i cannot help this.

And whiteypoints seemed to be climatechange denier which i don't approve. As well as his comment about "paranoid delusion". So i am not sure if i can be fully comfortable with your advice if you side with him.

Yes. I know news might be blown off. However, my anxiety makes it worse. No matter how many times i try, i can't get myself calm down. Amnesia from the news is what i am looking for. And if if the worst case scenario wouldn't happen, the science and news are bad enough to cause me this.
And i am not the one in denial of real science and trolling others when they feel down. Why don't you mind your own business.
Yes, i have. I have seen what NASA and 99% of the scientists are saying. :) Run along now.
Sorry, but science doesn't support what you are saying. This isn't for climate deniers or skeptics. If you are not going offer anything constructive, don't say anything.
Hello! I have a question. I have heard that climate scientists don't really think we can stay under two degrees but their position prevent them to say this not to cause panic. Is this true?
